measured.liveHeadSubject: D-353: record leftover-join.v32 of G21 as G21 leftover remasurement

evidence: Live git HEAD is 6c14185c1157c6b1ea0d081ee04659f0fd843798, whose subject records D-353, and the final live COORD heading is D-353.
basedOn.d353.role correctly says 'Last live heading at dispatch. Last-heading custody only,' while purpose and findingDisposition.lastHeadingCustody both declare it the sole claimant.
The three historical decision roles still assign present-tense last-heading custody to D-351, and the sarif role expressly names basedOn.d351.role as the sole claimant.
basedOn.d351.role itself says 'Not last-heading. Last-heading custody remains D-353,' so the sarif recital also contradicts the very role it identifies.

mustFix.whyMustFix: Last-heading custody is a recordability and provenance invariant expressly fixed by the dispatch, not optional historical commentary. The contradiction survives in four current candidate role strings even though the top-level HEAD and D-353 commit pin are correct.

A later leftover remasurement could cite this role as evidence that the per-platform copy authoring remains undone, contradicting the disk-backed catalog and corrupting authoring-remainder accounting.
shouldFix.whyNotMustFix: The false no-copy statement is confined to one explanatory basedOn role string. reviewSummary: REJECT at 2 unlabeled MUST-FIX and 1 unlabeled SHOULD-FIX. The subject and all four copies remain at their dispatched digests and mode 0444; each copy is a distinct regular four-byte file containing 00000001, an N=1 prefix with no body. All 31 permitted file-backed recorded inputs and all 28 permitted structured path/digest pairs reproduce, all five commit pins resolve, HEAD/COORD/file 08 agree, and the protocol, occupancy, platform and Windows quotations are exact. The candidate otherwise binds NOTHING, leaves OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING and prefix exactly at the operative bound open, measures no copy staleness, makes no SATISFIED or implementation-authorization claim, and preserves the frozen inputs. Rejection is required because four roles retain stale D-351 last-heading custody, the v28 role falsely calls the superseded D-351 join current, and the G10 role falsely denies v27's core four-platform copy act.
